tools.name: update_status
tools.description: Show the versions of the system on this computer (in use, previous, waiting for a restart, kept), the image the system follows and the state of updates. Reads only.

tools.name: update_preview_check
tools.description: Preview what a check for updates and the update manager would do next, and why: whether an update would be downloaded, would wait, or is refused. Runs no check and changes nothing.
